history.text: Moshoeshoe I gathered communities at Thaba Bosiu during the Difaqane upheavals.
Basutoland became a British protectorate at Moshoeshoe's request.
Independence came on 4 October as the Kingdom of Lesotho.
The Highlands Water Project began exporting water to South Africa.
